description: ACCDB full 4-route enforcement of field rule V.ValidationRule = "> 0 And < 10". Tests INSERT and UPDATE of pass(5), fail1(0), fail2(10), null(Null) through DAO Execute (128), DAO Execute (0), DAO dynaset AddNew/Edit+Update, and ADO Connection.Execute (ACE.OLEDB.12.0, fresh connection per write), first without ValidationText (3317 default text) and then with ValidationText = 'V rule failed' (3316 custom text). Records RecordsAffected, Errors, EditMode, stored row readback, and nativeRead keep:true bytes before and after every write.
